coverage.description: Construct equations from Is constraints, thing comparisons, time comparisons and wholes in that order using state queries. Run four passes over stored equations. After subst(sol), exactly one unknown u with coefficient a produces sol[u]=-(remaining expression)/a; zero or multiple unknowns cause no insertion.
